title: Statistical Inference for Probability Barycenters and Kolmogorov Moments
summary: A probability coordinate chart is a continuous strictly increasing bijection that transports observations to the open unit interval, where averaging is always well defined. For barycentric inference, the first coordinate moment is returned through the inverse chart. Higher initial coordinate moments similarly generate initial Kolmogorov moments by pullback, while centred coordinate moments remain on the probability scale. We develop inference for these quantities under fixed, intrinsic, and estimated charts. For a fixed benchmark chart, the coordinate mean is the primary inferential object.…
